RagShortTexts: The House of Barcelona unified Aragon and Catalonia under the red-and-gold Senyera,.

Variants.Content: The House of Barcelona governed the confederated Crown of Aragon under the four red stripes on gold of the Senyera banner. Led by James I the Conqueror (Jaume I), the dynasty conquered the Balearic Islands and Valencia, codifying Mediterranean maritime law into the Consulate of the Sea (Consolat de Mar).
James balanced urban Catalan commercial syndicates against conservative Aragonese baronies. His expansive maritime policies laid foundations for Aragonese hegemony across Sicily and the Aegean.
In Barcelona's Drassanes shipyards, shipwrights build light war galleys around the clock. Sailing under the Senyera promises rich shares of Levantine and North African cargo.
